name: att3-abench-base
command: B=tmp/att3/abench_base; for kv in 0 1; do $B --ctx 4096 --kv $kv --stream; $B --ctx 4096 --kv $kv --n 1 --reps 10; $B --ctx 4096 --kv $kv --n 1 --reps 10 --threads 1 --layers 2; $B --ctx 4096 --kv $kv --n 8 --reps 2; done; $B --ctx 256 --kv 0 --n 1 --layers 1 --reps 200; $B --ctx 256 --kv 1 --n 1 --layers 1 --reps 200

state_before.cmdline: coherent_pool=1M 8250.nr_uarts=0 snd_bcm2835.enable_headphones=0 cgroup_disable=memory numa_policy=interleave nvme.max_host_mem_size_mb=32 snd_bcm2835.enable_headphones=1 snd_bcm2835.enable_hdmi=1 snd_bcm2835.enable_hdmi=0  numa=fake=2 system_heap.max_order=0 iommu_dma_numa_policy=interleave smsc95xx.macaddr=<pi-mac> vc_mem.mem_base=0x3eb00000 vc_mem.mem_size=0x3ff00000  console=ttyS0,115200 console=tty1 root=PARTUUID=393ab1fb-02 rootfstype=ext4 fsck.repair=yes rootwait cfg80211.ieee80211_regdom=KR
